title: Make POSIX release launcher portable and smoke-test macOS installer
description:
Make the generated POSIX release launcher portable across macOS and Linux, and add macOS installer smoke coverage.

Problem:
Release artifacts target macOS and Linux, but the generated POSIX launcher uses GNU-style command forms such as readlink -- / dirname -- that are risky on macOS's BSD userland. Existing installer smoke coverage is strongest on Ubuntu and may miss macOS launcher failures.

Acceptance criteria:
- Replace GNU-specific POSIX launcher logic with a portable implementation tested on macOS and Linux.
- Preserve symlink resolution behavior expected by installer-created commands.
- Add or extend release workflow smoke coverage so macOS executes the installed launcher path users will actually run.
- Keep existing Ubuntu installer smoke coverage.
- Include focused tests or fixture verification for generated launcher content if practical.
close_reason: Portable POSIX launcher (no GNU dirname --/readlink --), refactored into exported render builders, added macOS to installer-smoke matrix, added releaseLauncher.test.ts (static + functional 2-hop symlink). Local release:smoke-installer passes. PR #320.
